title: Contract & document review
tagline: Ask plain-English questions of contracts, policies, and reports — and get answers with the exact passages they came from. The document is never uploaded anywhere.
scenario: Legal gets a 40-page vendor agreement an hour before the call. Instead of skimming, they drop the PDF on this machine and ask: what are the payment terms, when can we terminate, what are we on the hook for? Every answer shows its supporting passages — trust, but verify.
steps: The button below opens Docs Q&A with a question ready to ask.
Better: bring their PDF — upload it and let them ask the questions.
Expand “show the passages” to prove the answer is grounded in the document.

ctas.label: Run it live in Docs Q&A →
ctas.prompt: Summarize the key commitments, payment terms, and any deadlines in this document in plain language.

why.head: Confidentiality
why.body: the one document you can never paste into a cloud chatbot is exactly the one this handles.

why.head: Cited answers
why.body: every response links back to real passages, not model memory.

notes: The killer moment is uploading a document the customer brought — ask them beforehand to have a non-sensitive PDF handy.
Emphasize the passages panel: this is retrieval, not hallucination.
